Sales · Lead Generation

LeadPilot — AI LinkedIn Lead Generation Agent

Natural-language LinkedIn prospecting that scrapes, enriches, and outreaches — automatically.

▶ Watch Demo Video
Project SizeLarge (6+ tasks)
Deploy Time4–6 hours base setup, 2–3 days with customisations
ROI Impact$450/month saved per user (15 hrs × $30/hr SDR rate)

🔴 The Problem

Founders and sales teams were spending 15–20 hours per month manually searching LinkedIn for leads, copy-pasting contact info, and writing cold outreach from scratch. Slow, inconsistent, impossible to scale.

✓ The Solution

LeadPilot is an AI-powered web app where users type a natural language prompt — like 'Get me 3 CEOs of AI startups in San Francisco' — and the system handles everything: scraping LinkedIn, enriching contact details, storing results in Supabase, generating personalised cold emails, and sending them directly from the interface.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. User enters a natural language search query in the Lovable-built frontend
  2. n8n workflow triggers LinkedIn scraping utilities to extract matching profiles
  3. Contact data is enriched and stored in Supabase for history and retrieval
  4. OpenAI generates personalised cold outreach emails tailored to each lead
  5. Emails are sent directly from the app via connected email provider

🔴 The Problem

SDRs were taking hours to respond to inbound campaign replies, causing leads to go cold. Meeting requests got missed, proposals sat in inboxes, and the team lacked a system to triage hundreds of replies consistently.

✓ The Solution

An AI-powered email classification and routing system that processes every inbound reply the moment it arrives.   5. Info requests: query knowledge base and send answer
  6. Proposals: forward to exec inbox with AI summary
  7. Support: notify designated Slack channel
  8. Declines: send polite automated response

Priority Email Alert System

Critical emails from VIP senders forwarded to WhatsApp and Slack the moment they arrive.

▶ Watch Demo Video
Project SizeMedium
Deploy Time2–4 hours
ROI ImpactPrevents missed deals — potentially thousands in saved revenue

🔴 The Problem

High-priority emails from key clients and partners were being missed or delayed because the team could not monitor the inbox constantly. A single missed email could mean a lost deal.

✓ The Solution

A lightweight automation that monitors the inbox in real time. When a new email arrives, the system checks the sender against a managed Google Sheet VIP list. If matched, the email content is instantly forwarded to a WhatsApp group and a Slack channel simultaneously.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. New email arrives in Gmail/Outlook inbox
  2. n8n checks sender address against VIP list in Google Sheets
  3. If sender matches: forward email content to WhatsApp group via API
  4. Simultaneously post email content to designated Slack channel
  5. Non-VIP emails pass through without triggering the workflow

Sales Enablement · Outreach Automation

AI-Powered Multi-Channel Outreach

Personalised outreach across email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp with smart sequencing, A/B testing, and auto-pause.

▶ Watch Demo Video
Project SizeMedium to Large
Deploy Time8–12 hours
ROI Impact$1,000–$1,500/month + improved lead conversion rates

🔴 The Problem

Sales teams spent 60–70% of outreach time manually drafting messages, tracking follow-ups across channels, and logging results. Reply rates were low because messaging felt generic.

✓ The Solution

A multi-channel outreach orchestration system running from a Google Sheets lead list. AI generates tailored messages for each channel, smart sequencing handles follow-ups, A/B tests subject lines automatically, and pauses the sequence the moment a lead replies or books a meeting.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. New lead added to Google Sheets with name, title, company, channels
  2. OpenAI generates: personalised email, LinkedIn DM, WhatsApp message per lead
  3. Email sent via Gmail on Day 1; LinkedIn DM and WhatsApp message sent
  4. Smart delay before follow-up check
  5. Branching: reply detected → pause; no reply → follow-up; link clicked → escalate channel
  6. A/B testing: randomised subject line variants tracked per lead
  7. Meeting booked via Calendly → sequence halts automatically
  8. Performance dashboard updated in Google Sheets with full logs

Finance · Productivity

Smart Subscription & Expense Agent

Never miss a renewal or pay for a subscription you forgot about — AI manages your entire expense stack.

▶ Watch Demo Video
Project SizeMedium to Large
Deploy Time6–10 hours
ROI Impact$300–$800/month in avoided waste + 3–5 hours/week saved

🔴 The Problem

Individuals and teams were losing $300–$800/month to forgotten subscriptions, surprise renewals, and hours of manual expense tracking. Cancelling unwanted services required hunting through emails and account pages individually.

✓ The Solution

An AI personal finance assistant that centralises every subscription automatically. Upload an invoice or screenshot — the agent extracts vendor, plan, amount, and due date, stores it in a database, sets renewal reminders, and handles natural language commands like 'Cancel my Adobe plan' instantly.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. Trigger: new invoice/receipt uploaded via email, file upload, or screenshot
  2. OCR + AI extracts: vendor name, plan name, amount, billing date, subscription type
  3. System matches against existing records or creates new subscription entry
  4. Expense classified: recurring, one-time, or trial
  5. Renewal reminder sequence: alerts at 7-day, 3-day, and 1-day intervals
  6. Cancellation command detected: system looks up record and retrieves cancel link
  7. Direct cancellation attempted via Stripe/Paddle API if supported
  8. Expense reports generated on demand by vendor, category, or time period
  9. Overspend alerts triggered when unusual spending increases detected
